name: sheet1
sql:
CREATE TABLE "sheet1" (
"Date" TIMESTAMP,
  "Waybill Number" TEXT,
  "Postal Code" INTEGER,
  "Destination" TEXT,
  "Consignee" TEXT,
  "Customer Gender" TEXT,
  "Customer Age" INTEGER,
  "Age Range" TEXT,
  "Consigned Product" TEXT,
  "Sales Quantity" INTEGER,
  "Logistics Unit Price" REAL,
  "List Price Revenue" REAL,
  "Logistics Value-Added Service Revenue" REAL,
  "Discount Amount" REAL,
  "Total Logistics Revenue" REAL,
  "Freight Cost" REAL,
  "Warehousing Cost" REAL,
  "Other Operating Costs" REAL,
  "Total Logistics Cost" REAL,
  "Profit" REAL,
  "Profit Margin" REAL
)
